Sasha: quick check — I tried loading the 30B weights from s3://redwood-models/llama3-30b/quantized.pt and the runtime throws "RoPE scale mismatch: expected 1.0 got 0.5". anyone seen this?

Raj: that sounds like an MQA vs GQA mismatch. there are separate builds that used rope_scale=0.5 during training (MQA-style). which path did you pull from?

Sasha: path was s3://redwood-models/llama3-30b/quantized.pt (top-level). i noticed there is also s3://redwood-models/llama3-30b/mqa/ and s3://redwood-models/llama3-30b/gqa/. onboarding expects a single weights file in the model root which is ambiguous.

Emma: confirmed — packaging earlier moved MQA into a subdir but the loader code still assumes root. i can add a fallback search (root -> */mqa -> */gqa) but we should standardize.

infra-bot: automated hint: run `infra check-model --path s3://redwood-models/llama3-30b/ --validate meta,tokenizer,quant` to surface these mismatches.

Luis: tokenizer note: this checkpoint was exported with SentencePiece (legacy spec, unk_id=0). our default onboarding pipeline tries byte-level GPT2 tokenization if it sees no explicit tokenizer config. result: tokenization drift and embedding offsets. need `tokenizer_type: sentencepiece` in model meta or a `spm.model` present.

Sasha: ok i can add a quick shim to detect `tokenizer.json` vs `spm.model` and set `tokenizer_impl=sentencepiece`. i'll open a tiny patch.

Raj: sliding-window / KV cache: GQA variants need larger default kv_window. we saw quality regressions at 512. recommend default `kv_cache_window = 2048` for 30B GQA. runtime should override based on model.meta.long_context if provided.

Emma: agreed. runtime config currently has `kv.default=1024`. i'll change to read `model.meta.kv_window || kv.default` and make default 2048 for GQA heuristics.

Sasha: here's a small snippet i'll put in the PR for rope auto-detect:
```
// detect rope scale from model.meta or fallback to heuristic
float detect_rope_scale(meta) {
  if (meta.rope_scale) return meta.rope_scale;
  return (meta.quant == "mqa") ? 0.5 : 1.0;
}
```
will add tests.

Raj: nice. also log a warning when the loader overrides a rope_scale so we can trace onboarding mismatches.

Sam: canary note: once the tokenizer shim + rope auto-detect + kv_window change land, let's canary on Dedicated tomorrow 03:00 UTC. prefer small traffic (5%) and run the standard regression evals. i'll schedule. :calendar:

Emma: pinging @eng-runtime for code review on PR #412 — it bundles: weights-path fallback, tokenizer detection shim, rope detection, kv_window fallback.

Sasha: included a unit test vector for `rope_scale_detection` and a tokenizer roundtrip check with the provided spm.model.

Luis: one more thing — embeddings can drift if tokenization changes; add an eval that computes cosine similarity vs baseline for a short prompt set. if avg sim < 0.97 we fail onboarding.

Emma: good call. i'll add the eval to the PR CI.

Raj: LGTM on approach. small nit: update the model onboarding docs with the new recommended layout:
- model_root/weights.(pt|bin)
- model_root/meta.json (rope_scale, quant, kv_window, tokenizer_type)
- model_root/tokenizers/spm.model (if sentencepiece)

Sasha: will update docs and add a note to the release notes. TL;DR: blockers are fixed by PR, add tokenizer meta + kv_window to model bundle, then canary. any objections? :eyes:

Raj: no objections. :thumbsup:

Emma: none. marking ready-to-canary once PR is merged.

Sasha: merging after one more review. thanks everyone.
